questions: Who decides that Barbara C6 should trigger after an eligible death?
Where is the 15-minute cooldown represented and who authoritatively validates it?
Which 7.1 network/Ability path commits the dead avatar back to the alive state?

claims.statement: The 7.1 Barbara C6 talent installs an off-stage DoReviveMixin chain that starts hidden skill 10076 and executes ReviveAvatar for player avatars at full target max HP.

evidence.note: Barbara_Constellation_6 attaches the dedicated ReBorn abilities.

claims.statement: Hidden skill 10076 is the cooldown carrier for Barbara C6 and is expected to retain the 900-second cooldown in 7.1.

evidence.note: Skills 10076/10079/10080 have 900-second cooldowns; exact 7.1 skill-table row remains to be recovered.

claims.statement: The revive trigger is expected to cross the normal client-to-server Ability invocation path after the client executes the C6 resource chain.

evidence.note: AbilityInvocationsNotify carries client AbilityInvokeEntry values into server Ability processing; the exact Barbara argument remains unidentified.

claims.notes: This does not yet identify the exact 7.1 AbilityInvokeEntry emitted by ReviveAvatar.

claims.statement: It is not yet known whether the official server independently stores or validates Barbara C6 skill 10076 cooldown state.
The exact 7.1 path that commits the revived avatar to authoritative LIFE_ALIVE state is not yet identified.

rejected_paths.statement: Use a generic ReviveDeadAvatar action or its byServer field as direct evidence for Barbara C6 in 7.1.
rejected_paths.reason: The concrete 7.1 Barbara C6 action recovered from BinOutput is ReviveAvatar, and this block has no visible byServer field.
